scope: SLP Chapter 4 (Dynamic Programming under Certainty): the sequence problem and the functional equation in the extended reals, Lemma 4.1 and Theorems 4.2-4.5 (Principle of Optimality) with sufficient conditions for Assumption 4.2, Ex 4.1-4.3 and the consumption examples; bounded returns, Theorems 4.6-4.9 (with Chapter 3's contraction and maximum theorems carried over), policy iteration (Ex 4.4), Benveniste-Scheinkman and differentiability of the value function (Theorems 4.10-4.11, Ex 4.5); constant returns to scale, Ex 4.6-4.8 and Theorems 4.12-4.13; unbounded returns, Theorem 4.14 with the unit-elastic growth and quadratic investment examples; Euler equations, Theorem 4.15 and Ex 4.9.
source: Stokey, Lucas and Prescott (1989), Recursive Methods in Economic Dynamics, Chapter 4.
